items.title: Jensen Huang is back: Does Washington have a seat in the boardroom?
items.summary: As Nvidia reinstates Jensen Huang and investors add a trillion dollars to the stock, Deirdre Bosa dives into the White House's role in his return and asks General Catalyst's Madhu Namburi, who spent 25 years advising tech boards at J.P. Morgan, how boards, CEOs and dealmakers operate under the new rules.

items.title: Ex-Nvidia employee: 'Stability and accountability can coexist'
items.summary: Amulya Vishwanath, Techable VC Founder and Managing Partner and a former Nvidia (NVDA) employee, joins Yahoo Finance's Deirdre Bosa to discuss how Jensen Huang's return as CEO is good for founders and the company's execution and who must own the question of accountability.

items.title: Nvidia's stability is a systemic issue for the US now, this AI CEO says
items.summary: Unconventional AI CEO Naveen Rao joins Deirdre Bosa for a discussion about his own company's relationship with Washington regulators, especially in the context of President Trump intervening to press the Nvidia (NVDA) board to reinstate Jensen Huang as CEO.

items.title: It's not over for Jensen Huang
items.summary: Nvidia's board voted unanimously to bring back Jensen Huang as CEO, 11 days after he was pushed out, and the US stock market added $3 trillion within the hour. Host Ejaaz Ahamadeen breaks down what changes now, from the "bank of Nvidia" and chips for China to a more careful Jensen and what his return means for open-source AI.

items.title: Asian stocks rally as Huang's return to Nvidia revives the AI trade
items.summary: By Jiaxing Li HONG KONG, Nov 24 (Reuters) - Asian shares leapt on Tuesday following a spectacular Wall Street surge, as Jensen Huang's return as Nvidia CEO sparked a relief rally in the battered AI

items.title: Asia FX subdued as dollar holds near 20-mth high on AI rally
items.summary: Investing.com-- Most Asian currencies were little changed on Tuesday as the U.S. dollar held near a 20-month high, with the reinstatement of Nvidia (NASDAQ:NVDA) CEO Jensen Huang reviving enthusiasm for artificial intelligence and easing concerns over a potential slowdown in the U.S. economy.

items.title: Watch these chip stocks for bargain buys after Nvidia’s post-reinstatement rally
items.summary: Investing.com -- Jensen Huang was reinstated as Nvidia CEO on Nov 23, 2026, 11 days after he resigned, sparking a broad-based rally across battered chipmaking and artificial intelligence names on Monday.

items.title: Asian stocks rally as Taiwan leads with 9% rebound in AI trade
items.summary: Investing.com -- Most Asian stocks rallied on Tuesday, with Taiwan leading regional gains as Nvidia’s reinstatement of founder Jensen Huang revived enthusiasm for the artificial-intelligence trade following last week’s technology-led selloff.
